history_evidence.limit: Bounded official history inspection: the task and asset manifest have one GitHub path commit before the pinned revision; the pinned HF lastCommit records identify raw and truth as unchanged since their April addition. The first 50 HF commits and normalization commit tree were inspected; this is not an exhaustive search of all historical objects.

findings: Thirteen task source files and 60 shared files were reverified against pinned Git blob IDs and SHA-256 receipts. Four of six downloaded numerical/metadata assets match the benchmark manifest. Raw data and truth have the expected byte lengths but different SHA-256 hashes; their observed hashes exactly match the pinned HF LFS OIDs. This is a release mismatch, not a truncated download.

Downloaded low-dose weights and post-log measurements satisfy -log(weights/1000) exactly across 93952 bins; using metadata I0=300 shifts every ray by ln(1000/300)=1.2039728043259368. Seventeen bins have the source floor value one; their original zero-versus-one counts are not recoverable. High-dose data use I0=50000.

Downloaded truth ranges from 0 to 0.04. Manifest-verified physics fixture truth ranges from 0 to 0.06, has I0=300 and differs spatially from downloaded truth. The 204x204 central crop of this fixture exactly equals the metrics reference. Saved FBP/PWLS-low crops exactly equal their metric fixture estimates.

Pure metric replay reproduces fixture FBP NCC 0.7972260488601 / NRMSE 0.2392354997969 and PWLS NCC 0.9908081501021 / NRMSE 0.0428879340794. This establishes fixture-to-saved-array consistency only, not a matched input-to-output run or solver provenance.

The notebook retains a 1000-photon, 0..0.04 condition with unweighted/PWLS-low/PWLS-high NCC 0.9533/0.9854/0.9866 and NRMSE 0.1485/0.0851/0.0799. The released archive instead has recon_fbp, recon_pwls_low and recon_pwls_high; recon_unweighted is absent. Re-executing notebook loading would fail, and the historical values do not describe these saved arrays.

README/plan describe SVMBIR q-GGMRF and ICD; actual solvers.py uses SVMBIR project/backproject inside proximal-gradient TV code, normalizes count weights by their maximum and clips negative estimates. No call to svmbir.recon implements the advertised plan. generate_fixtures.py describes a 32x32, 18-view NumPy fallback with I0=10000, unlike the retained 256x256, 256-view, I0=300 fixture. These source functions were not executed.
Units conflict: README uses cm^-1 whereas metadata uses mm^-1, both with nominal unit detector/pixel spacing. No conversion or physical calibration is inferred.

Actual end-to-end scorer dispatch uses generic full-array scoring and output/reconstruction.npy. The separately registered task-aware helper chooses recon_pwls_low before recon_unweighted/recon_fbp and crops [26:230,26:230], 41616/65536 pixels. Neither path independently rescales the image. Scoring records explicitly distinguish fixture-reference diagnostics from incompatible downloaded truth.

Oracle, half-reference and outside-crop controls expose metric limits without reconstruction. Half-strength reference preserves NCC 1 but changes NRMSE. Outside-crop errors disappear from cropped scoring and remain in full-image scoring. When ground_truth is absent, generic reference discovery falls back to reconstructions.npz:recon_fbp; that fallback is not recovered truth.

No metrics.json appears in the pinned GitHub task tree, manifest or complete 14-entry HF task listing. The notebook thresholds 0.8868 and 0.0936 were not installed. Diagnostic scoring has no pass/fail status.

Actual L1/L2/L3 file-seeding methods copy the entire data directory, including the retained downloaded truth. The audit runs this only in a separate assembled diagnostic packet; all installer commands are intercepted. Source and evaluation directories remain unseeded. The source contract is not a hidden-reference challenge.

This is an assistant source audit, not explainer acceptance or scientific invalidation. No patient or model inference, reconstruction iteration, measurement generation, SVMBIR installation or changed historical score occurred.
